SELECT id, document_id AS documentId, knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, version_no AS versionNo, oss_id AS ossId, original_name AS originalName, file_suffix AS fileSuffix, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, file_hash AS fileHash, target_index_version AS targetIndexVersion, configuration_revision AS configurationRevision, processing_mode AS processingMode, text_embedding_profile_id AS textEmbeddingProfileId, text_embedding_profile_revision AS textEmbeddingProfileRevision, multimodal_embedding_profile_id AS multimodalEmbeddingProfileId, multimodal_embedding_profile_revision AS multimodalEmbeddingProfileRevision, vision_profile_id AS visionProfileId, vision_profile_revision AS visionProfileRevision, rerank_mode AS rerankMode, text_rerank_profile_id AS textRerankProfileId, text_rerank_profile_revision AS textRerankProfileRevision, multimodal_rerank_profile_id AS multimodalRerankProfileId, multimodal_rerank_profile_revision AS multimodalRerankProfileRevision, parse_status AS parseStatus, parse_error_code AS parseErrorCode, parse_error_message AS parseErrorMessage, parsed_at AS parsedAt, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT v.id, v.document_id, v.knowledge_id, v.version_no, v.oss_id, v.original_name, v.file_suffix, v.mime_type, v.file_size, v.file_hash, v.target_index_version, v.configuration_revision, v.processing_mode, v.text_embedding_profile_id, v.text_embedding_profile_revision, v.multimodal_embedding_profile_id, v.multimodal_embedding_profile_revision, v.vision_profile_id, v.vision_profile_revision, v.rerank_mode, v.text_rerank_profile_id, v.text_rerank_profile_revision, v.multimodal_rerank_profile_id, v.multimodal_rerank_profile_revision, v.document_processing_snapshot, v.parse_status, v.parse_error_code, v.parse_error_message, v.parsed_at, v.create_dept, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_version v ON v.id = d.current_version_id WHERE d.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND d.status != 'DELETED' AND v.parse_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY d.id
